entities.summary: Mongol, a notable figure in the history of Kyrgyzstan, associated with Mongol and Chagatai Period (1207–1370). Preceded by Mongol Conquest and Chagatai Khanate and Genghis Khan subjugates the Kyrgyz tribes of the Yenisei region. Their legacy influenced Moghulistan and Kyrgyz Migration.
